title: Detailed key
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Key shaft -->
  <rect x="22" y="44" width="62" height="12" rx="4" fill="#FFD54A"/>
  <!-- Shaft highlight -->
  <rect x="22" y="44" width="62" height="5" rx="4" fill="#FFE68A"/>
  <!-- Shaft shadow -->
  <rect x="22" y="51" width="62" height="5" rx="2" fill="#E6A817"/>

  <!-- Bow (handle) - outer ring -->
  <circle cx="80" cy="50" r="18" fill="#FFD54A"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="50" r="18" fill="none" stroke="#E6A817" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Bow highlight -->
  <path d="M66 42 A18 18 0 0 1 92 40" fill="none" stroke="#FFE68A" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Bow inner hole -->
  <circle cx="80" cy="50" r="9" fill="#2A1A3A"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="50" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#E6A817" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Decorative ring detail on bow -->
  <circle cx="80" cy="50" r="13.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFB300" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/>

  <!-- Key teeth -->
  <rect x="30" y="56" width="7" height="12" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD54A"/>
  <rect x="30" y="56" width="7" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#FFE68A"/>

  <rect x="42" y="56" width="7" height="16" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD54A"/>
  <rect x="42" y="56" width="7" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#FFE68A"/>

  <rect x="54" y="56" width="7" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="#FFD54A"/>
  <rect x="54" y="56" width="7" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#FFE68A"/>

  <!-- Teeth bottom shading -->
  <rect x="30" y="64" width="7" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#E6A817"/>
  <rect x="42" y="68" width="7" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#E6A817"/>
  <rect x="54" y="62" width="7" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#E6A817"/>

  <!-- Sparkle on bow -->
  <g fill="#FFF8D6">
    <circle cx="72" cy="38" r="2"/>
    <circle cx="88" cy="38" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="90" cy="58" r="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Small sparkles near shaft -->
  <g fill="#FFF8D6">
    <circle cx="20" cy="46" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="26" cy="52" r="0.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Tiny star accents -->
  <path d="M68 34 L69 32 L70 34 L69 36 Z" fill="#FFF8D6"/>
  <path d="M94 48 L95 46 L96 48 L95 50 Z" fill="#FFF8D6"/>

  <!-- Edge light on bow top -->
  <path d="M64 46 A18 18 0 0 1 76 33" fill="none" stroke="#FFF3B0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
